Title: Decentralized AI Infrastructure built on BrokerChain
Text:
Decentralized AI Infrastructure built on BrokerChain
Jianru Lin
jianru.lin@gmail.com
Sun Yat-sen University
GuangZhou, China
Abstract
The future of decentralized applications faces a significant challenge
in supporting the data and computational demands of modern tech-
nologies like large language models and real-time social platforms.
While current blockchain systems provide a robust foundation for
trust and security, they often struggle with the scale and perfor-
mance required for AI-driven applications. This gap stems from
limitations in on-chain data storage, high-performance computing,
and transaction latency.
This keynote presents BrokerChain, an exploratory project and
a novel architecture designed to address these challenges. We have
developed an integrated platform that supports a complete AI life-
cycle natively on-chain. This includes a high-throughput layer for
storing multi-modal data, a computing infrastructure that leverages
diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, and specialized hardware) for dis-
tributed training and inference, and an economic model that aims
to align incentives for data and compute providers. By proposing a
cohesive solution, BrokerChain seeks to simplify the complex and
costly process of combining disparate systems. This presentation
will share our findings and open up a discussion on how a purpose-
built blockchain might serve as a more effective foundation for the
next generation of decentralized, AI-enabled applications.
